title: Two Sum Less Than K
summary: Provide the highest sum from an integer array where the sum of any two distinct elements is less than k, or return -1 if no such pair exists.
statement: Provide the highest sum from an integer array where the sum of any two distinct elements is less than k, or return -1 if no such pair exists.
constraints: Choose two distinct indices whose sum is strictly less than k.
reference_solution:
def maximum_pair_below_k(nums, k):
 nums.sort();left=0;right=len(nums)-1;answer=-1
 while left<right:
  total=nums[left]+nums[right]
  if total<k:answer=max(answer,total);left+=1
  else:right-=1
 return answer

def maximum_pair_below_k(nums, k):
 nums.sort();left=0;right=len(nums)-1;answer=-1
 while left<right:
  total=nums[left]+nums[right]
  if total<k:answer=min(answer,total);left+=1
  else:right-=1
 return answer
hints: After sorting, pair sums move monotonically with either pointer.
If a pair is too large, decrease right; otherwise record it and increase left.
For each left endpoint, the accepted right is its largest feasible partner, so no better pair is skipped.
